name: Di Jiu Dang'an - Wangguan Pian
source:
That was in 2009.

The location is an old industrial city in northwest China. The air is filled with the smell of cigarette smoke and dust. The sounds of keyboard tapping, players' shouting and the humming of computer fans fill the ears.

You are a computer science intern working the night shift at an internet cafe. This place serves as a refuge for the city's homeless. Through your eyes, you will witness the lives of those who have nowhere else to go.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4244480/]Steam[/url]]
